investigation_notes: Network security investigation of a monitored LAN. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over Zeek and Suricata logs (IDS alerts, Kerberos, HTTP downloads, TLS certificates, domains and external-destination activity). No root cause, impact or C2 attribution is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Network context: LAN segment range: 192.168.5.0/24 (192.168.5.0 through 192.168.5.255); Domain: clockwater.net; Domain Controller: 192.168.5.5 - Clockwater-DC; LAN segment gateway: 192.168.5.1; LAN segment broadcast address: 192.168.5.255.
